name: Codex prompt task contract proof boundary
decision: Every non-trivial KRN task contract should name objective, non-goals, allowed and forbidden writes, verification, proof and non-proof boundaries, rollback, and next-task synthesis so Codex can execute surgically and report what evidence actually proves.
falsifier: An active generated task lacks non-goals, allowed/forbidden writes, verification, proof/non-proof boundary, rollback, or next-task synthesis while still being treated as ready for execution.
doesNotProve: This card does not prove every tiny edit needs a verbose prompt, that perfect prompts replace verification, or that green commands prove product readiness.
